verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB says it gives each agent run its own throwaway branch of production data, running on isolated compute over the same S3. It also offers isolated read-only compute so agents cannot affect production, and a free dev instance for experimentation. Together these directly address sandboxed testing without touching production. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how branches isolate writes from production (copy-on-write semantics, lifecycle, limits), how to create a branch via CLI or MCP, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing-page claims.
